title: UploadRecord
description: The machine form of the single ownership record described in references/40-authorization.md. One row per upload. The transfer layer is never the source of truth for anything in it.

appUploadId.description: Application-owned identifier. Carries real entropy and is never derived from a filename.

transferUploadId.description: The transfer layer's own upload id, taken from the Location header of the creation response.

resourcePath.description: The path the client was given. Treated as a capability: never logged, never exported, re-checked on every method.

ownerSubject.description: Authenticated actor that owns the upload.

targetService.description: The service this upload is destined for. Re-checked against the caller's permission at completion, from this stored value and never from the client's.

declaredSize.description: The size the client declared. Upload-Length must equal it exactly.

allowedMetadata.description: Allowlisted metadata values only, normalised to strings. Never raw client metadata.

objectKey.description: Server-generated. Contains no client-supplied segment and no filename, and includes the tenant or project prefix.

state.description: Control-plane state. Distinct from the client-visible state list in assets/client/uploadStates.ts, which is shorter and exists for the UI.

validatedContentType.description: Determined server-side. The only content type anything downstream may trust.

failureCode.description: A stable code. Never a raw provider message.

lastActivityAt.description: Drives the retention threshold for unfinished uploads.

expiresAt.description: The value sent to the client as Upload-Expires. A client that never receives it retries into a 404.
